title: Configure idevice-backup
description: Global options for the iOS backup module

retention.title: Backups to keep per device
retention.description: How many backup snapshots to keep per device; older ones are pruned after a successful backup.

include_backups.title: Include device backups in the NS8 backup
include_backups.description: Add the (potentially large) device backups to this module's NS8 backup. Off by default; only pairing records and the registry are carried.
